# Ashlands ruins

Type: Structure | Internal ID: AshlandRuins | FortressRuinsCharredTowerRuins | Location: Ashlands | Inhabitants: Charred Twitcher, ,, Morgen

# Introduction

Ashlands ruins are broken structures built from Grausten scattered throughout the Ashlands.
The largest variants of ruins are Charred Ruins.

## Resources

Fiddleheads and Smoke puffs can be found in the ruins.
Ruins can also be destroyed to get Grausten. The foundations of these ruins also can be destroyed, but they can only take Pickaxe damage. An efficient way to destroy them is either baiting Morgen or Lava Blob to damage these ruins.

## Creatures

In addition to the regular Spawn zones mechanics, Ashlands ruins have a chance to appear with extra Charred Twitchers or Morgen that only spawn once.
